{{Quote|Damn Skotia! What business has he, going behind my back, speaking to my apprentice! Trying to intimidate you, no doubt. Wretched monster. More machine than man and dangerously powerful. Ever since I've arrived on Dromund Kaas as an apprentice, he's made every effort to stand in my way.|Lord Zash|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Skotia''' ({{Pronounced|ˈskoʊʃə}}, occasionally /skoˈteˈa/) was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived during the era of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Skotia was a native to the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and was an active member of the [[Sith Order]] as a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Sith Warrior|warrior]]. At some point during his career, more than half of Skotia's natural appendages and organs were replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] machinery, including his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and many [[Brain/Legends|neural]] transmitters. Regardless, by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Skotia had been elevated to the position of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] as a member of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]] and was in command of a cadre of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] warriors who had sworn to protect the Sith as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. Under the auspices of his superior, [[Darth Thanaton]], Skotia maintained [[Darth Zash's chambers|offices]] within the [[Sith Sanctum]] in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and gained guardianship over the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] hollowed ground known as the [[Dark Temple]]. Skotia was stationed on Dromund Kaas when the newest servant of the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge arrived on planet&mdash;the young and ambitious [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Darth Zash|Zash]]. The progressive [[Sith sorcerer|Sith witch]] quickly developed a heated rivalry with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] Dark Lord who, along with Thanaton, detested Zash's lack of deference to her historical predecessors. Skotia very deliberately attempted to impede her ascendance, but the aspiring [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] ultimately earned Lordship and was granted supervisory powers over [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Sith training|training]].

Skotia's rivalry with Zash continued until around [[3643 BBY]], at which point the Darth discovered that Zash, who had succumbed to the draining effects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], was seeking to use [[Sith sorcery/Legends|hidden power]] within the Dark Temple to achieve immortality through an ancient and dangerous [[Essence transfer|Force ritual]]. The Dark Lord promptly forbade Zash from entering the Temple and ordered the destruction of her [[Darth Nox|new apprentice]], who had just completed the trials of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Skotia's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts on the apprentice failed, allowing Zash an opportunity to use her new student as a means of eliminating her old rival. Skotia tried several times to confound his enemy's plans, but Zash's apprentice overcame the Dark Lord's efforts and [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|confronted]] the cyborg in his chambers in the Imperial Citadel. Although Skotia was confident he could [[Death/Legends|kill]] the apprentice, the young Sith managed to undermine the Dark Lord's control of his Trandoshan guardsmen and even wielded a [[cyber neutralizer]] device that disrupted and deactivated Skotia's control of his prosthetic body parts. The elder Sith was slain by the apprentice, thus fulfilling Zash's designs and allowing the Sith witch to accrue more influence on Dromund Kaas and advance towards her ultimate goal of immortality.

==Biography==
===Warden of ancient knowledge===
{{Quote|Everything you've done here, everyone you've dealt with&mdash;Lord Zash included&mdash;is insignificant. Darth Skotia has eyes and ears on Korriban. He knows what your master is up to and he is displeased to say the least. On Korriban, Lord Zash may have her way but on Dromund Kaas it's a different story.|Ortosin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
===Outfoxed by Zash===
{{Quote|Give your master a message for me: My eye is on her, and I know. Tell her that. I know what she's trying to do here, on Dromund Kaas. You and your master have gotten this far&mdash;but it ends here, slave. I alone have the key. Tell her that. You and your master have no future on Dromund Kaas or in the Sith Order. Tell her that. Now, get out of my way.|Darth Skotia|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Skotia learned of [[Darth Zash|Zash's]] attempts to unlock the secrets of an artifact of [[Tulak Hord]]. He sent one of his apprentices, [[Ortosin]], and two agents to [[Duel in the Sith Academy|assassinate]] her [[Darth Nox|new apprentice]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] but they failed. When the apprentice arrived on Dromund Kaas, Skotia intercepted the Inquisitor at the spaceport and attempted to intimidate them. News of this infuriated Zash. Knowing that she couldn't kill Skotia, for a power play would make the [[Dark Council]] nervous, she decided to dispatch her apprentice, [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], instead to infiltrate Skotia's [[Darth Skotia's bunker|base]], which was guarded by Skotia's army-sized force.

[[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|Gathering]] a [[Trandoshan relic|tablet]] that would force Skotia's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bodyguards, [[Skeesk]] and [[Skarsk]], to abandon him and a [[Cyber neutralizer|cyborg prototype disruptor]] that could disable someone who is 50% or more cyborg, the Apprentice [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|confronted]] Skotia in his chambers with [[Khem Val]] and the Sith Lord. He killed the bodyguards when they turned on him, but the cyborg disruptor greatly weakened him enough to be killed. The cyborg was defeated, and his cybernetics weakened him from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and he was no match against the powerful Inquisitor. With his last breath, Skotia realized that Zash must have spent years plotting his demise, and realized that the Sith would always betray one another. He warned her apprentice that she would turn on her/him before he died.

News of Skotia's death didn't go unnoticed. Darth Thanaton accused Zash of murdering Skotia but couldn't prove it as many could claim that she was in the Nexus Room Cantina the whole time. Zash was then elevated to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] and gained access to Skotia's position and assets.

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|I cannot be tied to Skotia's murder. Brazen power plays make the Dark Council nervous. But nobody could believe that a mere apprentice could defeat Skotia. It's impossible.|Lord Zash|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
[[File:Darth_Skotia.png|thumb|right|200px|Darth Skotia]]
To receive the title of "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]," Skotia must have had considerable power, enough to outmatch a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] at least. Even Zash recognized that he'd be near impossible to defeat without the mechanisms/weapons her apprentice gathered. When his bodyguards turned against him, he showed his incredible abilities with [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] discarding of them rather easily. He was also proficient with [[Force Enrage|Force rage]], enacting it during his duel with the [[Darth Nox|apprentice]]. Even though he was weakened considerably by Zash's apprentice's weaponry, he still presented a challenge in the lightsaber duel that ensued when he attacked the apprentice but was ultimately defeated and slain.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What do you think? Can you eat him?''"<br />&laquo;''It is more machine than man, I think. Bad for the digestion.''&raquo;|[[Darth Nox|Kallig]] and [[Khem Val]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />|trans=1}}
Many Sith, especially Darth Zash, saw Skotia as a brutal, malevolent cyborg.

However, when Skotia was killed and Zash was given his chambers and assets, she was surprised that Skotia had vast amounts of research and knowledge in his chambers; she never knew he was that intellectual and admitted that she didn't want him dead for his impeccable curiosity to gain knowledge.

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Skotia's name refers to the Ancient Greek word ''skotía'' (σκοτία), which means darkness or gloom.
